notes.title: Valor & Victory: Pacific is now available on PC
notes.notes:
The Pacific War was a theater of immense strategic importance, with nations vying for control over key territories and vital supply routes. 

Valor & Victory: Pacific plunges you into this theater of war, where the forces of Japan and China join the fray.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2522840/Valor__Victory_Pacific/

Discover the difficulties faced by Australian troops as they resisted the unrelenting Japanese assault and eventually launched their own counteroffensive via the dangerous Kokoda Trail. 
Assist the US Marines in defending the Henderson airfield perimeter against wave after wave of Japanese attacks. Fight against reinforced Japanese defenders who refuse to surrender. And battle with Chinese forces in an offensive to reopen the vital Burma Road.

Tune in today on our [url=https://www.twitch.tv/slitherinetv]Twitch Channel[/url] at 8 PM GMT where Richard Yorke will show you the new DLC.

notes.title: Valor & Victory: Kursk - out now
notes.notes:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2470540/Valor__Victory_Kursk/

Kursk, the fourth DLC for Valor & Victory, is out now.

[previewyoutube=zI7iOnrihX4;full][/previewyoutube]

In an effort to reverse their fortunes in Russia, the Germans committed their best forces to the Battle of Kursk. However, they were met with an unyielding Russian defense. Contrary to expectations, the German troops encountered devastating resistance, despite their unwavering efforts. While their attacks made some headway into the deep Russian defenses, they suffered significant losses. On July 7, the Russians unleashed increasingly heavy tank forces, further challenging the German advance.
Despite heavier casualties suffered by the Soviets, the Battle of Kursk marked a significant success for them. Historians attribute a tactical victory to the Soviets at Kursk, as they effectively halted the German advance.

To enhance your tactical arsenal, 10 new maps have been introduced, each designed to reflect the rugged terrain of the Eastern Front. 
Maneuver your forces wisely and exploit the unique features of each battlefield to gain the upper hand.
In addition, 3 new armor units have been deployed to the frontlines, providing you with more strategic options to dominate your adversaries. 
Furthermore, the new Panzer Grenadier units will bolster your infantry forces, adding versatility and resilience to your ranks.

And that’s not all. Today we also announced the next DLC Valor&Victory: Pacific, which plunges you into this theater of war, where the forces of Japan and China join the fray.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2522840/Valor__Victory_Pacific/

With Valor & Victory: Pacific, a wealth of new content awaits you. 
Brace yourself for the introduction of two new nations, Japan and China, bringing fresh perspectives and strategic choices to the game. 
Engage in immersive battles across new maps, each meticulously designed to portray the unique challenges of jungle warfare. 
Prepare for intense combat encounters amidst dense foliage, where every step counts.

Tune in today on our [url=https://www.twitch.tv/slitherinetv]Slitherine Twitch Channel[/url] at 7.30pm BST where Yodgog will show you the new DLC.

After downloading Valor & Victory: Kursk, do not miss the chance to sign-up to the new tournament “Battle of Kursk”. You can sign-up [url=https://www.slitherine.com/tournaments]here[/url].
The tournament follows Swiss Tournament rules: you can find the full list of rules [url=https://www.slitherine.com/tournaments/rules]here[/url].

notes.title: Valor & Victory: Arnhem launches September 29th on PC

Announcing Valor & Victory: Arnhem, the third DLC for Valor & Victory, launching September 29th.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33792772/85a06dae1ac9948da6191cf33e620b1604eda1df.jpg[/img]

Arnhem, Sunday 17th September. Lt-Col John Frost's 2nd Battalion, The Parachute Regiment, reached Arnhem Bridge little knowing the fierce battles they would be fighting over the next few days.

Refight SS-Kampfgruppe Graebner charged across the bridge from the southern end. He fought off continuous attacks by 9th SS as they battled to retake the approaches to the bridge.

Can you survive the 25 turn "A Bridge Too Far" scenario as the British when Kampfgruppen Hummel, Brinkmann and Knaust arrive with the aim of surrounding and destroying you?

The Battle of Arnhem contains [b]6 scenarios[/b] focused around the battles for Arnhem bridge with [b]a large map[/b] depicting the bridge and town.

Stay tuned!

notes.title: Valor & Victory: Shield of Cholm - out now
notes.notes:
Shield of Cholm, the second DLC for Valor & Victory, is out now.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33792772/14480fb9e0dcb0b3992004a9d0a98673c5dade77.jpg[/img]

It’s January 1942 and the Soviet Red Army has begun a series of counter offensives against the German Army. The Germans have started to withdraw and have occupied the strategic town of Cholm. To keep the offensive going the Russians need to capture Cholm. The Germans, from their perspective, could ill afford to lose this strategic point. Very quickly, the town of Cholm became surrounded and was cut off, creating what was then called the Cholm Pocket.

The new DLC features [b]two huge maps[/b], larger than any released in Valor & Victory so far, and [b]twelve new scenarios[/b] that occur on the large maps, or on smaller areas of the maps.

[b]New units[/b] have also been introduced: Partisans, Conscripts, Russian Assault Engineers as well as [b]new terrain types[/b]: rubble, debris, escarpments & ice.

Valor & Victory: Shield of Cholm is based on the Kampfgruppe Scherer supplement from Le Franc Tireur. It releases alongside an [b]update of the base game[/b]: with the [b]Battle Generator[/b] you can now create random scenarios and choose the sides as well as the scenario size and force types; with the [b]Fog of War[/b] option opponents can now choose to be hidden when not in LOS. Also a difficulty balance has been introduced: you can manage [b]Dice bias[/b] for a harder or easier game.

Tune in today on our [url=https://www.twitch.tv/slitherinetv]Slitherine Twitch Channel[/url] at 3.30pm GMT where Hexaboo will show you the new DLC.

notes.title: Valor & Victory: Shield of Cholm is coming soon
notes.notes:
[b][u]Shield of Cholm[/u], the second DLC for Valor & Victory, will be available on [u]July 7th, 2022[/u][/b].

Cholm’s emergence onto the stage of historical events of World War II came about as a result of the Russian Winter Offensive of 1941-1942. In January 1942 the Soviet Red Army began a series of counter offensives against the German Army. The Germans started to withdraw and occupied the strategic town of Cholm. To keep the offensive going the Russians needed to capture Cholm. The Germans, from their perspective, could ill afford to lose this strategic point.

Despite the appearance of a run of the mill Russian village, Cholm was of strategic significance: it held a bridge across the lengthy Lovat River and dominated a road nexus of four main roads amid an otherwise large, marshy and low lying area .

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33792772/41f71ebe81e791546d2c50d9ad394d85a81706cd.jpg[/img]

The DLC comes with an update of the base game:

[b]Battle Generator[/b]

Create random scenarios

Choose the sides, scenario size and forces types

[b]Fog of War[/b]

Per scenario option for opponents being hidden when not in LOS

[b]Difficulty Balance[/b]

Manage Dice bias for a harder or easier game

 
The Shield of Cholm DLC is based on the Kampfgruppe Scherer supplement from Le Franc Tireur.

[b]12 New Scenarios[/b]

Huge maps, larger than any released in Valor & Victory so far.

[b]New Units[/b]

Partisans, Conscripts, Russian Assault Engineers

[b]New terrain types[/b]

Rubble, debris, escarpments & ice

notes.title: Valor & Victory - Stalingrad Assault
notes.notes:
If you are already missing [b]Valor & Victory[/b] tournament, you want to know this, a [b]new public tournament[/b] of Valor & Victory: Stalingrad is starting on [b]April 15th[/b]. 

The assault of Stalingrad has begun! Fight to attack or defend Stalingrad in the following tournament rounds:
In this tournament you will challenge other players in three different scenarios:


[b]Round 1 - The German Assault Begins - 6 game turns[/b]

The German Assault on Stalingrad begins with a two-proged drive on the center and southern district of the city. Elements of the 14th Panzer Division push into what's left of the Yelshanka Suburbs, resisted by elements of the 593rd Rifle Regiment, 131st Rifle Division.


[b]Round 2 - The Railway Station - 6 game turns[/b]

As the German assault continues, extra reserves are committed to the fight, pushed into the gigantic Stalingrad No1 Rail Station. Here the remnants of the 1st Battalion / 42nd Guards Rifle Regiment trade blows with intermingled grenadier platoons of the German 71st Infantry Division and tanks of the 24th Panzer Division.


[b]Round 3 - Ludynikov's Island - 6 game turns[/b]

The Germans have broken the last slivers of Russian defense into smaller pockets. One of these is Ludnynikov's Island. Snow blankets the city's ruins. Here we see part of the southern arm of the assault on the Island pitting "Pionier" Battalion 50 and units of Infantry Regiment 576 against remnants of 650th Rifle Regiment, 138th Rifle Division.


[b]Please note, the new Stalingrad DLC is required to play in this tournament.[/b]

To enter, go to the tournament page and sign up by clicking [url=www.slitherine.com/tournaments]HERE[/url].

The tournament follows Swiss Tournament rules: you can find the full list of rules by clicking [url=www.slitherine.com/tournaments/rules]HERE[/url].

notes.title: Valor & Victory: Stalingrad is out now!
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone,

We are pleased to announce that [b]Valor & Victory: Stalingrad[/b] is out [b]NOW[/b]. 

Valor & Victory: Stalingrad is the first DLC for Valor & Victory, the squad-level tactical game set in World War II and based on the original counter board game. 

In this DLC, a brand new playable faction has been introduced to the game: [b]the Soviet Union[/b]. It comes with its own new units, support weapons, anti-tank guns, armour, transports and more.

Set in the Eastern front, fully featuring the [i]entirety[/i] of the [b]Battle of Stalingrad[/b], perhaps the most important battle in World War II and turning point of the war. There are [b]14 new, exciting scenarios[/b] that follow the historic events as well as [b]13 new maps[/b].

The new scenarios are extremely varied and will provide you with new and original tactical situations that you will need to face. Moreover, hills and ravines are included, blocking or enhancing LOS. Units can move around the terrain using hills and valleys without being seen by the enemy. On top of that new terrain types have been introduced, so you can have even more map variety. 
The Stalingrad DLC will be released alongside a free update for the base game. This update will contain significant additions in the form of [b]new content and features[/b] to better represent the close conflict of the era. These include: [i]infantry mortars, flamethrowers and off-board artillery support as well as air support, snipers, minefields, and more[/i].

Artillery has long been known as the king of the battlefield, but snipers were also a primary source of unseen fear. The Stalingrad DLC introduces them both to Valor & Victory. 

Snipers are activated when an opposing infantry unit rolls a natural 12 while making an AP or AT attack. They have the ability to appear in cover within LOS of the attacking unit that triggered the sniper, simulating their ability to be lurking literally anywhere. 

Enjoy the DLC and let us know what you think about it!

notes.title: Valor & Victory is out now
notes.notes:
Valor & Victory, the digital version of the [b]classic hex and counter tabletop wargame[/b], is out now.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/963870/Valor__Victory/

With 20 scenarios based around real events shortly after the Normandy Landings in 1944, the game challenges you to achieve different objectives: eliminate the enemy, capture objectives or exit certain units off of the map.

[previewyoutube=jv9t3TyHSnA;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Battle of Douvres Radar Station - 77th anniversary[/h2]
The game features the [b]Battle of Douvres Radar Station[/b], which took place on June 17th, 1944. Today marks its 77th anniversary: the British 41 Commando, Royal Marines led the attack supported by the tanks of the 79th Armoured Division. The Radar at Douvres was the main Luftwaffe radar station in the area. It was a fortified position with five radars, minefields, bunkers and ringed by barbed wire. The scenario covers the final assault by 41 Commando with a couple of Shermans in support. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33792772/b39f45fdb44f7d07ace6fd1293bed315a8977cee.png[/img]

[h2]Manual and tutorial videos[/h2]

Check out the [url=https://matrixgames.com/amazon/PDF/Valor_Victory_Manual_EBOOK.pdf][b]PDF manual[/b][/url] for a complete guide to your first steps. You can also have a look at these [url=https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLk5K-IfEIqTtDZE10hsN6kUTJyN1A0PP2][b]tutorial videos[/b][/url] to find out how the turn phases play out and how to build your own scenarios with the built-in scenario editor.

[h2]Sign up for the "Operation Overlord" tournament[/h2]
Valor & Victory launches with tournament support: if you're looking to test your skills, you can [url=https://www.matrixgames.com/tournaments]sign up[/url] here and join the Operation Overlord tournament. All you need to do is sign up, then the system will pair you with opponents and create your PBEM games. You will be notified by mail of when the tournament is starting, and when it will be time to play your turns.

The tournament will officially start on [b]July 1sr[/b], and it will include three rounds, each one lasting 21 days.

You will challenge your opponents in three scenarios:

[list]
[*] June 6th, 1944 - St. Marie Du Mont, France
[*] June 6th, 1944 - The Fight for Colleville, France
[*] June 17th, 1944 - Battle of Douvres Radar Station, France
[/list]

[h2]Tabletop Wargames - Steam Exclusive Bundle[/h2]
Valor & Victory launches with a Steam exclusive bundle: if you're into World War 2 board games and you already own [b]Heroes of Normandie[/b], you'll get a 15% discount on Valor & Victory.

Check it out!

notes.title: How to play #1
notes.notes:
Valor & Victory, to be released on June 17th, is entering the last stage of beta testing, and we're now running a beta tournament. If you're in the beta and would like to help, you can sign up [url=https://www.matrixgames.com/tournaments]here[/url].

The gameplay in Valor & Victory is as loyal as possible to the original boardgame, and each turn is divided into specific phases. This first video tutorial covers Command Phase and Fire Phase.

[b]Command Phase: [/b]the game starts with the Command phase, during which you will be able to combine and split your squads and exchange weapons.
[b]Fire Phase: [/b]simply select the units and then click on any enemy in line of sight to order your units to shoot. Then wait for the die roll to determine the combat outcome. The die will take into consideration your total Firepower and any potential hindrance modifier.

[b]Check it out![/b]

[previewyoutube=az4eszajGs0;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Valor & Victory is coming soon
notes.notes:
The [b]Matrix Games[/b] and [b]Yobowargames[/b] teams have proudly partnered together to publish Valor & Victory.

Valor & Victory is a fast-playing, easy to learn World War II squad-level game system. Based on the original Valor & Victory board game, the digital edition provides you with an accessible and deep challenge, developed for classic tabletop game lovers.

[previewyoutube=GMXqxtSGwBM;full][/previewyoutube]

With [b]20 scenarios[/b] based on real events shortly after the Normandy Landings in 1944, the game challenges you to achieve different goals: eliminate the enemy, capture objectives or move certain units off of the map.

Valor & Victory is a complete WWII wargaming system, covering infantry and armored combat, close assaults, armored overruns, fortifications, and much more.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/963870/ss_527c21b12609f6411074cda85c87a687088a242f.1920x1080.jpg?t=1613468351[/img]

Valor & Victory comes with full multiplayer support: challenge your friends in 1v1 multiplayer matches over PBEM or in hotseat mode. If you’re looking to test your skills, sign up for official tournaments and climb the leaderboard as well.

An extremely intuitive built-in scenario editor allows you to build and play your own scenarios either against the AI or against your friends. Pick a map, set the objective, choose the factions, place units and defenses where you prefer. Add details and customize your rules: decide the number of turns, the weather conditions and the starting team. The scenario editor gives you all the tools to create custom challenges without limitations.

[b]JOIN THE BETA[/b]

Valor & Victory is looking for beta testers: [url=https://www.matrixgames.com/beta/valor-and-victory]apply now[/url] and help us improve the game.
